signals.title: HSY Q3 deep dive: innovation pipeline and productivity efforts shape outlook amid muted volume trends
signals.summary: Chocolate company Hershey (NYSE:HSY) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3% year on year to $3.28 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.64 per share was 25.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
signals.title_de: HSY Q3 Deep Dive: Innovations-Pipeline und Produktivitätsbemühungen prägen den Ausblick inmitten gedämpfter Volumentrends

signals.title: In Biden’s First Halloween In Office, A 100-Piece Bag Of Candy Cost $9.91, A Study Found. This Year It’s $16.96, And Government Data Shows Candy Prices Rose 7.7% In A Year, More Than Double Overall Inflation
signals.summary: Halloween candy prices have climbed far faster than anything else in your shopping cart, and Hershey's latest earnings report reveals exactly why candy makers have little reason to stop raising prices anytime soon.
signals.title_de: In Bidens erstem Halloween im Büro kostete eine 100-Stück-Süßigkeit 9,91 US-Dollar, eine Studie gefunden. In diesem Jahr sind es 16,96 US-Dollar, und Regierungsdaten zeigen, dass die Süßigkeitenpreise in einem Jahr um 7,7% gestiegen sind, mehr als die doppelte Gesamtinflation

signals.title: The Real Halloween Scare: Candy Prices Surge
signals.summary: Candy and chewing gum prices have climbed 7.7% over the past year, more than double the 3.7% increase in the Consumer Price Index.

signals.summary: The Dot’s and LesserEvil maker is taking steps to boost production and packaging options by adding manufacturing lines and investing in automation.

signals.title: Hershey warns Americans squeezed by gas prices are buying less candy—and Halloween’s final days are ‘really critical’
signals.summary: Candy sales at convenience stores fell 5% in September, and Hershey’s exec says the company now needs consumers to “show up” in the last days before Halloween.
signals.title_de: Hershey warnt Amerikaner, die von den Gaspreisen gedrängt werden, kaufen weniger Süßigkeiten - und Halloweens letzte Tage sind "wirklich kritisch"

signals.summary: Americans are expected to spend a record $13.5 billion celebrating Halloween this year, but surveys show some households are cutting costs elsewhere.
